about_the_game:
This is the full soundtrack for Cardinal Sequence. It includes all in-game tracks as well as some additional tracks from related media like trailers.

You can use these tracks in any video or live stream as long as those videos are not used to advertise in any way. I only ask for you to communicate where you got this music from.

Re-uploading or streaming these songs without providing significant value of your own is prohibited.

In essence, you can use these tracks as background music in your videos or streams without worry but may not use them as music for advertisements, trailers, games and so on.
